name: mimg_list_models
description: List the image models available for generating and editing, each with its per-image credit price. Call this FIRST: it is the only way to know a valid `model` id, what a generation will cost, and — via each entry's `modes` — which models can EDIT an existing image rather than only create one from text. Each entry is {model, provider, kind, modes, source_input_key, per_unit_credits, unit, notes}; `modes` contains 'text-to-image' and/or 'image-to-image', and `per_unit_credits` is in micro-credits (divide by 1000 for credits). Takes no parameters. Read-only and free.
